about_short_description.short_description: Malibou is a web tool that enables French SMBs to manage personnel, conduct payroll, and maintain compliance all in one app.

product.name: Payroll and Social Declarations Platform
product.description: A platform that centralizes payroll management and social declarations for French SMBs, automating payroll closure, payments, and compliance with collective agreements.

product.name: Absences and Telework Management
product.description: A tool to centralize and manage employee absences and telework schedules within a unified planning interface.

product.name: Expense Report Management Software
product.description: A software solution for digitizing, validating, and tracking employee expense reports, including integration with payroll for reimbursements.

product.name: Time Management System
product.description: A system to monitor and manage employee working hours and compensation modalities for overtime or other time-based adjustments.

product.name: Employee Performance and Interview Tracking
product.description: A module to centralize employee performance reviews and interview campaigns, offering templates to facilitate the process.

product.name: Dedicated Payroll Expert Support via Chat
product.description: A communication channel that connects users directly with a dedicated payroll expert for real-time assistance and payroll verification.
